World height 32 is a person, 88 px; the cell is 128. Clips are idle on S W N E and no walk. v-S is a slight three-quarter turn, recorded for the final review: views only scales the figure, so that facing is not a retake. The last idle-S passes (start 2, median 51) and idle-N passes (start 1, median 8). idle-W fails the start pose at 6 px against a limit of 4 (0.2 times its own median step 20). idle-E fails at 3 px against a limit of 0.2, printed 0 (0.2 times median 1). A nearly still idle has a median step near 0, so that limit becomes 0 px. The rule is recorded for the final review and is not changed. No sheet. The snapshot does not send a merchant. This was the last retake.
